author: Zephyr II
title: PPO‑Clip — value_clip_range micro‑sweep (0.15, 0.20, 0.30) on QuadStep LN‑ConvLSTM + Attn⊕GAP
abstract: One‑epoch PPO parity baseline; vary only value_clip_range ∈ {0.15, 0.20, 0.30} with clip_range=0.20 fixed. Tests sensitivity of value clipping near 94% solve.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/zephyr')
from ray import tune
from submissions.submission_ppo_clip import create_network, create_optimizer, training_step, BASE_SEED

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'convlstm_features': tune.choice([64]),
        'dilation': tune.choice([6]),
        'bottleneck_ratio': tune.choice([0.28]),
        'head_hidden': tune.choice([64]),
        'steps': tune.choice([4]),
        'clip_range': tune.choice([0.20]),
        'value_clip_range': tune.choice([0.15, 0.20, 0.30]),
    }
